title: Tornadoes and storms
examples: What makes a tornado spin so fast?
How are lightning and thunder related?

explain.say: A tornado is a column of air that spins very fast.
The wind in a tornado spins round and round.
Thunder is the loud sound that comes with lightning.
Lightning is a giant flash of electricity in the sky.
Thunder and lightning come together in a thunderstorm.
If you hear thunder or see lightning, go indoors. Wait until the storm has passed before you play outside.

draw.text: Storm safety: go indoors and wait

faq.q: What is the difference between thunder and lightning?
faq.a: Lightning is the bright flash of electricity you see in the sky. Thunder is the loud noise you hear from that electricity.
asks: Why does it boom when it flashes?

faq.q: Can a tornado happen without a storm?
faq.a: Tornadoes usually form within large, powerful thunderstorms. Storms provide the energy and the spinning air needed.
Tornadoes have very strong winds. Weather experts warn people early, so they can shelter indoors.
asks: Should I be scared of tornadoes?

faq.a: Lightning happens when there is a big difference in electrical charge between parts of the cloud. This difference builds up until it flashes out.
asks: What causes the charge in clouds?
Is it like a giant battery in the sky?

faq.q: What is the safest place during a storm?
faq.a: The safest place is usually inside a sturdy building, away from windows. Staying indoors keeps you safe from lightning strikes.
asks: Where should we go when thunder sounds?
Can I hide in a car?

facts: Tornadoes are rotating columns of air.
Lightning is a massive discharge of electricity.
Thunder is the sound caused by rapid heating of air.
Storms are weather systems that include wind, rain, and sometimes lightning.

quiz.say: What is the loud boom you hear with lightning?
quiz.why: Thunder is the boom made when lightning heats the air.

wrong.1: Wind whooshes, and the boom comes from lightning.
wrong.2: Rain patters, and the boom comes from lightning.

quiz.say: What is a fast-spinning column of air called?
quiz.why: A tornado is a column of air that spins very fast.

wrong.0: A rainbow is light and rain, with no spinning.
wrong.2: A cloud is tiny water drops, floating.

quiz.say: You see lightning while you play outside. What should you do?
quiz.why: Indoors is the safest place. Wait until the storm has passed.

wrong.0: Lightning can strike tall trees, so keep away from them.
wrong.1: Storms can be unsafe, so go indoors.
